verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's first-party open-source HyperAgent extends Playwright with AI so developers write natural-language commands instead of complex selectors (docs-23, docs-17). The example `page.ai("search for flights..., select the cheapest option")` shows natural-language page driving (docs-2), but it is a multi-step agentic task rather than discrete act/click/type primitives on described elements. Missing for 10: documented granular act/click/type primitives targeting described elements, evidence of DOM-understanding element resolution, proof of robustness to selector/layout changes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
